remarks:
This hunting and recreational property consists of 8.2 acres (lot 4) and is located in South Dayton NY, Cattaraugus County.

The land is fully wooded with hardwoods and some scattered pine. The terrain is mostly level and easy to access. Great opportunity to build a nice cabin or park your camper. There is a creek running through the property.  Electric is located at the road, and there is 250 feet of road frontage. Great hunting with whitetail deer and turkey sign throughout. All rights convey.  More acreage is available upon request.

This property is located approximately 12 minutes from Cherry Creek NY, 20 minutes from Little Valley NY, 30 minutes from Ellicottville NY, 35 minutes from Jamestown NY, 37 minutes from Dunkirk NY, and 1 hour from Buffalo NY.
